pick.headline: Oslo II interim agreement signed in Washington
pick.fbis: The Near East & South Asia Daily Report of September 28, 1995, carried an interview in which Arafat said that for the first time the Palestinian authority would control the whole populated West Bank, and proposed Jerusalem as "capital for two peoples."

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Near East & South Asia, No. 188, 28 September 1995

alternates.headline: Pope John Paul I dies after 33 days
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 29, 1978, listed under West Europe & Canada a TASS report of the death of Pope John Paul in the Vatican.

alternates.headline: The ferry Estonia sinks in the Baltic
alternates.fbis: The Central Eurasia Daily Report of September 28, 1994, listed under Estonia a Baltic News Service item that the president had declared a day of mourning over the ferry accident.
